name: Ogura Minamo
source:
A straight peasant girl who is very emotional, but also simple and gentle, though a bit clumsy. Skillful at swimming but poor with machines. She is nicknamed as the "Island's Mermaid" due to her swimming skills. Born into a distinguished family, also the Chief Village's grandchild, she is proud of her long hair that resembles her death mother's. Her parents died in an accident related to the sea.

[Edited from [url=https://dnandre.wordpress.com/2012/05/02/galge-preview-dolphin-divers/]dnandre's review[/url]]
